composition_subtypes.role: Scans substrings with two pointers maintaining two balance counters

payload.core_composition_summary: The solution uses a single greedy two-pointer technique to scan all substrings, maintaining maximum and minimum possible balances to check validity.
payload.rationale: The code iterates over start indices and extends a window, updating two numeric states (dp[0] and dp[1]) greedily; it is not a DP with subproblem reuse. This is a classical greedy two-pointers approach.
